Crochet Braids Appointments Near Oakland, CA

What are crochet braids?

Crochet braids are a hairstyle in which a base of cornrow braids is created at the scalp, and hair extensions are installed using a crochet sewing hook. This affordable style is versatile and reduces styling time as the extensions can be purchased pre-styled. Some popular styles of crochet braids include Faux Locs, Crochet Box Braids, and Crochet Havana Twists.

How much should you tip for your crochet braids?

Tipping 20 percent of the total cost for your crochet braids appointment is the best rule of thumb to follow. Consider varying your tip based on the cleanliness of the braider’s working area, their friendliness, and your satisfaction with the results.
